Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
RONGEUR, KERRISON 



1. Scope — Material, dimensions and other requirements for Kerrison rongeur used in neurosurgery. 

2. Material 

2-1 Shaft and Arms — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 40Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972 ' Specifica- 
tion for stainless steel bars and flats \ 

2.2 Spring — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972. 

2.3 Screws and Pins — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972. 

3. Type, Shape and Dimensions 

3.1 The Kerrison rongeur shall be of the following two types: 

a) Type 1 — Having up-bite jaws, and 

b) Type 2 — Having down-bite jaws. 

3.2 Shape, sizes and dimensions for Kerrison rongeur shall be as shown in Fig. 1 unless 
otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

3.2.1 Up-biting tip angled at 45° may also be provided, if required by the purchaser, other 
requirements remaining unchanged. 

3.3 A deviation of ± 2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3.4 Joint— Shall be box type as shown in Fig. 1. 

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The rongeur shall be of a symmetrical and balanced construction. 

4.2 The biting-tip end shall be either flat or slightly curved in both up-bite and down-bite jaws. 

4.3 The movable jaw shall slide evenly and without any stiffness, jerks or play. The tip of the 
movable jaw shall have a sharp edge and shall be recessed to provide a good cutting action. The 
tips shall register accurately to facilitate efficient shearing. The slot and sliding arrangement shall 
be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

4.4 The screws shall be well formed. 

4.5 The rongeur shall be free from surface defects like scales, burrs, pits, seams, cracks, etc, on its 
internal as well as external surfaces. The gripping portion of the handle shall be matt finished or 
suitably grooved to facilitate gripping. The rongeur shall be polished bright and passivated. 

4.6 Heat Treatment — The rongeur shall be suitably hardened and tempered to give a uniform 
hardness of 500 to 590 HV. 

5. Tests 

5.1 Performance Test — Bite a rib bone or teakwood of 3 mm thickness with the rongeur jaws. This 
shall be done easily and cleanly. The test shall be repeated five times. On completion of the test, 
biting jaws as well as the rongeur as a whole shall show no sign of damage. % 



Adopted 26 May 1978

^Corrosion Resistance Test — Subject the rongeur to boiling and autoclaving test as prescribed 
in IS : 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel 
surgical instruments \ 

5.2.1 At the end of the test, no red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dullina of 
the polished surface may be permitted. 

6. Marking— The Kerrison rongeur shall be marked with the following information by etchina or 
otherwise: y 

a) Manufacturer's name, initiats or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The words ' Stainless steel \ 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
